planets.name: K2-317 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-317 with a 6.22-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-317 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-317. Its orbit and size follow Castro González et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
